mutations.name: digest serves every withheld initiative regardless of the caller
kills: digest --personal serves an agent caller no row from an owner-only initiative

mutations.name: digest lists loops before the next-14-day section
mutations.find:
...section(`Due in the next ${UPCOMING_DAYS} days`, digest.upcoming.map(itemRow)),
    ...section('Trigger-met loops', digest.loops.map((loop) => `${loop.slug} ${loop.ref} ${loop.text}`)),
mutations.replace:
...section('Trigger-met loops', digest.loops.map((loop) => `${loop.slug} ${loop.ref} ${loop.text}`)),
    ...section(`Due in the next ${UPCOMING_DAYS} days`, digest.upcoming.map(itemRow)),
kills: digest --personal lists overdue, next-14-day, trigger-met and stale items in that order

mutations.name: digest prints every line uncapped
kills: digest --personal caps the listing at 30 lines and keeps only the top five stale items

mutations.name: digest keeps every stale task
kills: digest --personal caps the listing at 30 lines and keeps only the top five stale items

mutations.name: digest prints an empty section as a bare header
kills: digest --personal prints every section with a none line when there is nothing to list
